notes.title: Unleash the Adventurer Within!
notes.content:
Your suggestions have been our main source of guidance ever since we launched the game. We're dedicated to creating a world that's richer, more vibrant, and captivating.

Here's a glimpse of the enhancements awaiting you in version 1.2r

[u][h3]Forge weapons, armor, and potions![/h3][/u]Discover new crafting structures for weapons, armor, and potions, empowering you to become the ultimate artisan of your fate.

[u][h3]Nighttime intensifies with more mobs & loot![/h3][/u] Brace yourself for more thrilling encounters! We've amped up the challenge with increased mob density at night, along with better loot drops from defeated monsters. The darkness holds more than ever before.

[u][h3]Dash Into Action![/h3][/u] Feel the rush of adrenaline as you dash into combat! Unlock the ability to perform a short dash while in motion, adding a dynamic new dimension to your movement arsenal.

[u][h3]Customize Your Controls![/h3][/u] Take control like never before with our new keyboard controls rebinding feature. Tailor your gameplay experience to suit your style and dominate the battlefield with ease.

[u][h3]Revamped Settings Menu[/h3][/u] Dive into a smoother experience with our overhauled settings menu. Adjust your preferences effortlessly and fine-tune your gaming experience to perfection.

[u][h3]Audio Optimization![/h3][/u] Lose yourself in the soundscape with optimized background music and enhanced sound effects.

[u][h3]Bug Fixes & Optimization[/h3][/u] We've squashed numerous bugs and made optimizations across the board, ensuring a smoother, more immersive gaming experience.

We've fixed the pesky swimming animation bug, ensuring you glide through the water with grace and fluidity.

Join us as we embark on this epic journey together. Update now and let the adventure begin!

Thank you for your unwavering support and feedback. Happy adventuring, brave souls!

notes.title: Update for Enhanced Gameplay Experience!
notes.content:
I've been making updates to the game since its initial release to address raised issues and feedback. This update is packed with enhancements aimed at providing you with a smoother, more immersive gaming experience.

Here's a rundown of what you can expect in update 1.08r:

[u][b][h3]Convenience Features:[/h3][/b][/u] Experience greater convenience with auto-equipping of tools when interacting with gatherable and mineable materials, as well as optimizations on the opening of crafting windows for all crafting benches.

[u][b][h3]Improved User Interface:[/h3][/b][/u]  Enjoy smoother navigation with optimizations to the map, minimap, and UI elements, along with increased inventory size for better item management.

[u][b][h3]Streamlined Gameplay:[/h3][/b][/u]  Say goodbye to pesky bugs with our comprehensive bug fixes, ensuring a more seamless gaming experience from start to finish.

[u][b][h3]Enhanced Visuals:[/h3][/b][/u]  Dive deeper into the game's world with improved visual feedback on construction and better lighting settings across all levels.

Optimized Performance: Benefit from smoother camera movements, refined camera settings, and optimized code for more efficient delivery of Steam achievements.

With each update, I'm committed to enhancing your gaming journey and delivering the best possible experience. Dive into the latest version today and embark on an adventure like never before!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback — I couldn't do it without you. Happy gaming!

notes.title: Guardians Unleashed: Survive in "Ruins of Majika"
notes.content:
Hello brave defenders! Join me on an exciting journey through the evolution of "Ruins of Majika," a solo survival adventure that thrusts you into the frontline of a battle against monstrous forces aiming to obliterate your base. Over the past year, I've poured my dedication into creating an experience that merges resilience and strategy.

It all began with a dream of crafting a game where players become guardians, defending their base against hordes of monsters. Fueled by the essence of defense and the thrill of facing overwhelming odds, I embarked on the mission to bring this vision to life.

The game evolved into a dynamic adventure, blending survival elements with the core concept of defending a base from impending doom.

I extend my gratitude to the community for their feedback and to the players who joined in playtesting. As the ruins of Majika beckon, I invite you to immerse yourself in a world crafted with passion, determination, and an unwavering belief in the magic of strategic defense.

May your adventures in Majika be as enchanting as the journey it took to create them. Until we meet in the ruins, fellow defenders, stand resolute, and may the heart of your base beat strong against the encroaching darkness. The story of "Ruins of Majika" is not just mine but belongs to every defender ready to face relentless waves and emerge victorious in this captivating world.
